material.notes: ROUND 85: rows are now pointer targets in the Material sheet (looks_z85.hover_rows: collection.row carries a hover-only region and lays on-surface at the 8 % hover opacity over the row, over secondary-container when selected) and each cell has its own buffer so its row keys are unique (a row's key is its line number; cells sharing a buffer lit the first cell's row). The rows are Cascadia Mono 12 sp (the sheet rig has no Roboto Mono; the Cupertino sheet does the same with Consolas; at 14 sp its descenders ran into the next row's fill). Measured: hover layer ece5ed light / 252229 dark on surface (exact for on-surface 8 %), selected rows secondary-container e8def8 / 4a4458, text on-surface 1d1b20 on e8def8 13.2:1 (dark e6e0e9 on 4a4458 7.2:1), on the page 16.2:1 / 14.3:1. All six cells viewed light and dark at 1x and 1.5x, no clipping. The viewer has no focusable element (the host owns keyboard focus and the caret), so its focus cell equals rest by construction; the scrollbar thumb is the shared 4 dp thumb (on-surface-variant 50 %, about 2.4:1 on the surface, as in the ready scroll_bar row). M3 has no terminal: the list row and colours are the M3 list tokens.
gaps: No M3 terminal; monospace face is a stand-in for Roboto Mono; focus cell equals rest by design; shared scroll thumb about 2.4:1
